Borrowed from Vulgar Latin *potestāre, from Latin potestās (“power, ability”), whence Albanian pushtet (“power”). Cognate with Medieval Latin potestare (“to control”), Old French poëster (“to exercise power, to govern, to dominate; to put in power”), Italian podestare. The dialectal forms poshtroj, pështroj are influenced by shtroj.
